metadata.title: Lettuce Dataset with RGB Canopy Images, Biomass, Nutrient Solution, and Environmental Variables for Machine Learning Model Development
metadata.description:
This dataset contains RGB canopy-cover images, environmental data (Temperature, relative humidity), nutrient solution (EC), and corresponding biomass (fresh weight) measurements of butterhead lettuce (Lactuca sativa var. capitata) grown in a nutrient film technique (NFT) hydroponic system. The experiment was conducted at the Department of Biological and Agricultural Engineering, University of California, Davis.  

See the video here for the time-lapse.

The experimental system consisted of a two-tier NFT rack supporting a total of 70 lettuce heads (Figure_1a). Environmental variables and nutrient solution properties were continuously monitored throughout the experiment (Figure_1b). The cultivation cycle ran from February 21, 2024, to March 23, 2024.  

More information and citation: 
1) Karimzadeh, S., McAllister, R. D., & Ahamed, M. S. (2026). OptiDose: An optimal control for macronutrient dosing in hydroponics. Computers and Electronics in Agriculture, 243, 111428.

2) Syed, S., Ahamed, M. S., Karimzadeh, S., & Omwange, K. (2026). Real-Time Lettuce Biomass Forecasting in Indoor Vertical Farming Using Machine Learning Framework. Journal of the ASABE, 69(1), 105-118.

------------------------------------

Dataset Contents  

The dataset includes the following components:  

  1. - **Canopy Cover Images (folder: "Canopy Cover") **
      - Hourly overhead RGB images captured with an Intel® RealSense™ Depth Camera D405, positioned above the lettuce canopy.  
      - Images are labeled according to plant position (see Figure_1 for reference).  
  2. - **Environmental and Nutrient Data ("Environment_Solution.xlsx")**  
      - Time-series data of environmental and solution dynamics, averaged at 30-minute intervals.  
      - Variables include:  
        - Water temperature  
        - Air temperature at upper and lower tiers
        - Relative humidity at upper and lower tiers 
        - Electrical conductivity (EC) of the nutrient solution  
        - Nutrient reservoir volume  
  3. - **Biomass Measurements ("Biomass.xlsx")**  
      - Daily non-destructive weighting of fresh biomass (grams) for 18 reference lettuce heads (B22–B47, see Figure_1 for reference).  
      - Measurements span the entire cultivation cycle (Days After Transplanting, DAT).  

------------------------------------

Figures  

**Figure_1. Experimental Design**  
  Growth rack layout with two cultivation levels, flow direction, sensor placement, nutrient reservoir, and camera position.  
**Figure_2. Canopy Cover Labeling and Biomass Growth**  
  Example canopy image with labeled lettuce heads (B22–B47) and corresponding biomass time series.  

------------------------------------

Notes  
- Lettuce heads are consistently labeled (B22–B47) for cross-referencing between canopy images and biomass data.  
- Environmental and biomass datasets are aligned temporally with the image collection period.
